title: Separate Field Scoring Protects Unused Tools When Agents Pool Tool-Use Experience
abstract: arXiv:2610.30867v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents that call tools from a shared catalog can pool what they learn about which tool serves which request. We measure what pooled usage examples do to tool retrieval, reporting separately the held-out tools, for which no agent has usage, and all other tools. Adding usage examples to the index as extra entries for used tools raises Hit@5 (whether a gold tool is in the top five) for those tools and lowers it for held-out tools, by a large margin on two of three catalogs and with both embedders we tested. Giving used tools the same number of equally long entries filled with other tools' text lowers held-out Hit@5 about as much, but gives little or none of the gain. We call our method of scoring usage as its own field SYNAPSE. On StableToolBench, the held-out gold tool appears in its top five more often than with a router that reserves slots for usage (0.785 against 0.683), and this held-out lead holds on all three catalogs with both embed

translated_title: 分离字段评分：当智能体汇集工具使用经验时保护未被使用过的工具
translated_abstract: 从共享工具目录中调用工具的智能体可以汇集它们学到的关于哪种工具适合哪种请求的经验。我们测量了汇集的使用示例对工具检索的影响，并分别针对从未被使用过的预留工具和所有其他工具进行报告。将使用示例作为已使用工具的额外条目加入索引，会提高这些工具的Hit@5（即正确工具是否出现在前五名），但在三个工具目录中的两个以及我们测试的两种嵌入器上，会大幅降低预留工具的Hit@5。如果给已使用工具添加相同数量、等长但填充其他工具文本的条目，预留工具的Hit@5会下降相近的幅度，却几乎不带来任何增益。我们将这种把使用记录作为独立字段进行评分的方法称为SYNAPSE。在StableToolBench上，预留的正确工具进入前五名的频率高于为使用记录保留槽位的路由器方法（0.785对0.683），并且这一在预留工具上的优势在所有三个工具目录和两种嵌入器上均保持成立。
tldr: 提出SYNAPSE方法，将工具使用记录作为独立字段进行评分，在智能体共享工具使用经验提升已使用工具检索效果的同时，有效避免了从未被使用过的工具检索性能的下降。
en_tdlr: SYNAPSE scores tool usage records as a separate field, improving retrieval for used tools while protecting never-used tools from performance degradation when agents pool tool-use experience.
